YouTube Thumbnail Coach v1.0.0

- Initial release: expert system to audit, design, and A/B test YouTube thumbnails for higher CTR across niches.
- Evaluates thumbnails on visual hierarchy, contrast, emotion, scale, curiosity gap, and mobile readability.
- Recommends proven thumbnail formulas, face strategies, text rules, and color theory by niche.
- Supports channel branding audits, thumbnail vs. title analysis, and low CTR troubleshooting.
- Guides users on effective A/B testing of thumbnail variants for optimized performance.
